subject: english
question:
Parts of a sentence are given below in jumbled order. Arrange the parts in the correct order to form a meaningful sentence.

(A) to become severely seasick

(B) a world tour, but he was

(C) a nervous flyer and tended

(D) he wanted to go on
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 4**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The sentence describes someone's conflicting desires and conditions: wanting to go on a world tour while dealing with fears and health issues related to travel.&l
